notes.title: Release notes v1.1
notes.content:
We've released the first patch for Draugen. Version 1.1 addresses a couple of serious issues along with a few minor ones.


Unreal Engine upgrade from version 4.20 to 4.22, fixing a crash-to-desktop on older AMD GPUs
Tweaked texture pooling settings to improve overall texture quality
Fixed an achievement that was unavailable in v1.0: 'The Conversationalist'. You will need to replay the ending of the game (choose 'Continue' from the main menu) to receive the achievement, if you've already finished the game
Fixed some minor graphical glitches in the game


Thanks for playing, and please let us know if you discover anything new with this version!
